GATHERING_MINUTES.name: gathering-strength-minutes
GATHERING_MINUTES.comment: Real-life minutes a storm spends in GatheringStrength before advancing to EnteringReality.

ENTERING_MINUTES.name: entering-reality-minutes
ENTERING_MINUTES.comment: Real-life minutes a storm spends in EnteringReality before collapsing and regenerating the land.

ENTERING_INTENSITY_MULTIPLIER.name: entering-intensity-multiplier
ENTERING_INTENSITY_MULTIPLIER.comment: Multiplies max concurrent enemies and ember particle density during EnteringReality.

ENEMY_SPAWN_INTERVAL_SECONDS.name: enemy-spawn-interval-seconds
ENEMY_SPAWN_INTERVAL_SECONDS.comment: Real-time seconds between enemy spawn attempts per storm. Requires a server restart to take effect (sets a tick listener's interval at startup).

FOG_PARTICLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.name: fog-particle-interval-seconds
FOG_PARTICLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.comment: Real-time seconds between ember particle bursts. Requires a server restart to take effect.

EMBER_PARTICLES_PER_COLUMN.name: ember-particles-per-column
EMBER_PARTICLES_PER_COLUMN.comment: Ember particles spawned per chunk column, per burst.

FOG_FADE_SECONDS.name: fog-fade-seconds
FOG_FADE_SECONDS.comment: Real-time seconds for the in-storm fog effect to fade in/out when crossing a storm boundary.

STORM_MEMBERSHIP_INTERVAL_SECONDS.name: storm-membership-interval-seconds
STORM_MEMBERSHIP_INTERVAL_SECONDS.comment: Real-time seconds between player storm-boundary checks. Requires a server restart to take effect.

MAX_CONCURRENT_ENEMIES.name: max-concurrent-enemies
MAX_CONCURRENT_ENEMIES.comment: Per-storm cap on live spawned enemies (before the EnteringReality multiplier).

ENEMY_ENTITY_CODES.name: enemy-entity-codes
ENEMY_ENTITY_CODES.comment: Entity codes spawned during GatheringStrength, comma-separated, e.g. game:drifter-normal, game:drifter-deep.

ENTERING_ENEMY_ENTITY_CODES.name: entering-enemy-entity-codes
ENTERING_ENEMY_ENTITY_CODES.comment: Entity codes spawned during EnteringReality (replaces enemy-entity-codes entirely while active), comma-separated.
